# AMC Arabesque

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · light · built on vita · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

Contemporary Arabic heritage: a deep emerald header with a faint eight-point star lattice, restrained gold accents, a warm ivory page, generously rounded regions and an Arabic-first font stack.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_arabesque.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-arabesque.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-arabesque.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-arabesque` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

Light style built on Vita for Arabic and bilingual business apps. The header is deep emerald with a subtle eight-point star (girih) lattice drawn as an inline SVG, underlined by a thin gold rule; the page is warm ivory, regions are rounded and softly lifted, and the primary color is an emerald that passes WCAG AA with white text. Gold is used only for ornament (header rule, current menu marker, region title marker), never for text. The font stack puts IBM Plex Sans Arabic and Noto Sans Arabic first when installed (optional, not shipped) and falls back to Segoe UI, Tahoma and the system font, with a slightly taller line height for Arabic script. Designed for RTL first; header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
